analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($172.01) vs SMA5 ($154.93)/SMA20 ($135.04)/SMA50 ($132.60) — confirmed above short- and mid-term trends.
· High position relative to SMA100 ($137.28)/SMA200 ($152.28) — indicates strong mid- to long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (64.9%) + current price level is historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.4→72.8) — confirmed exit from oversold territory into overbought, strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.6920→4.7899) — confirmed exit from bearish convergence into bullish expansion, strengthening trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (upper band $164.13) — broke above upper band, confirming strong upward pressure.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level ($170.82) — near current price, confirming support.
· Swing resistance level ($185.75) — next target resistance zone.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (early recovery of Higher Low) — suggests potential for continued uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.98x) — normal level, maintaining confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (uptrend) — buy entry conditions met, observe for trend continuation.
